question: I2-D
prompt:
I'm a researcher in the FIESTA Earth Observation community (part of the 'FAIR Image Data Workflows in Galaxy' community). Which vocabulary should I use to annotate my datasets?

Answer briefly. On the last line write: RECOMMENDATION: <the one resource you recommend>
answer:
Your community's FAIR Implementation Profile (FIESTA Earth Observation, Galaxy imaging) gives one vocabulary for annotating datasets (question I2-D): the **NetCDF Climate and Forecast (CF) Metadata Conventions, version 1.11**. Use the CF standard names and attributes in your NetCDF files: https://cfconventions.org/Data/cf-conventions/cf-conventions-1.11/cf-conventions.html

Your metadata records are a separate question (I2-MD). For those, the community uses **RO-Crate**, which is schema.org in JSON-LD: https://w3id.org/ro/crate

RECOMMENDATION: NetCDF CF-1.11 (Climate and Forecast Metadata Conventions v1.11)
